title: The Return of the Pumpkin Rabbit
original_title: The Return of the Pumpkin Rabbit
overview: On Halloween night in 1983, four friends enter the long-abandoned Waterman House near Nash-Lake, drawn by curiosity and the local legends. As they explore the dark hallways and forgotten rooms, they are overcome by the feeling that they are being watched. What begins as a harmless adventure slowly turns into a terrifying struggle as the children realize that the stories about the place might be far more real than they ever imagined.
